(function () {
  const old = document.getElementById("xb-prompt-capture-panel");
  if (old) old.remove();

  let orig = null;
  let myHook = null;
  let checkTimer = null;
  const TARGET = "chat-completions/generate";
  const PANEL_ID = "xb-prompt-capture-panel";

  // ── 检测：当前任务是否被禁用 ──
  function isMyTaskDisabled() {
    try {
      if (window.isXiaobaixEnabled === false) return true;
      var cb = document.getElementById("scheduled_tasks_enabled");
      if (cb && !cb.checked) return true;
      if (typeof taskContext !== "undefined" && taskContext && taskContext.taskName) {
        var hit = window.XBTasks && window.XBTasks.find(taskContext.taskName);
        if (hit && hit.task && hit.task.disabled) return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // ── 格式化 message content（兼容字符串和数组）──
  function formatContent(content) {
    if (typeof content === "string") return content;
    if (Array.isArray(content)) {
      return content
        .map(function (c) { return c.text || c.content || ""; })
        .join("\n");
    }
    return String(content || "");
  }

  // ── 提取并格式化 messages ──
  function extractMessages(data) {
    var messages = data && data.messages;
    if (!Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) return "";
    return messages
      .map(function (m) {
        return "【" + (m.role || "unknown") + "】\n" + formatContent(m.content);
      })
      .join("\n\n---\n\n");
  }

  // ── 安全读取请求体（兼容 URL+options 和 Request 两种调用方式）──
  async function safeReadBody(input, options) {
    try {
      if (input instanceof Request) {
        var cloned = input.clone();
        return await cloned.text();
      }
      var body = options && options.body;
      if (!body) return "";
      if (typeof body === "string") return body;
      if (body instanceof Blob) return await body.text();
      if (typeof URLSearchParams !== "undefined" && body instanceof URLSearchParams)
        return body.toString();
      return "";
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  }

  // ── hook fetch（只读请求体，不修改、不阻塞）──
  function start() {
    if (orig) return;
    orig = window.fetch;

    myHook = function (...args) {
      var input = args[0];
      var url = String(input instanceof Request ? input.url : input || "");
      if (!url.includes(TARGET)) return orig.apply(this, args);

      // 异步读取请求体，不阻塞原始请求
      safeReadBody(input, args[1])
        .then(function (bodyText) {
          if (!bodyText) return;
          window.__lastPromptRaw = bodyText;
          try {
            var data = JSON.parse(bodyText);
            window.__lastPromptModel = data.model || "";
            window.__lastPromptMessages = data.messages || [];
            window.__lastPromptContent = extractMessages(data);
          } catch {
            // 不是合法 JSON，退回原始文本
            window.__lastPromptContent = bodyText;
          }
        })
        .catch(function () {});

      return orig.apply(this, args);
    };

    window.fetch = myHook;
  }

  function stop() {
    if (!orig) return;
    // ★ 只在自己是最外层 hook 时才恢复，避免覆盖其他 fetch hook
    if (window.fetch === myHook) {
      window.fetch = orig;
    }
    orig = null;
    myHook = null;
  }

  function cleanup(reason) {
    if (reason) console.log("%c[Prompt Capture] " + reason, "color:#f87171");
    stop();
    if (checkTimer !== null) {
      clearInterval(checkTimer);
      checkTimer = null;
    }
    try {
      var panel = document.getElementById(PANEL_ID);
      if (panel) panel.remove();
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  async function copyToClipboard() {
    var c = window.__lastPromptContent;
    if (!c) {
      icon.textContent = "❌";
      setTimeout(function () { icon.textContent = "✍️"; }, 1500);
      return;
    }
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(c);
    } catch {
      var ta = document.createElement("textarea");
      ta.value = c;
      ta.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:-9999px";
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      document.execCommand("copy");
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
    }
    icon.textContent = "✅";
    setTimeout(function () { icon.textContent = "✍️"; }, 1500);
  }

  // ── UI：单图标 ──
  var isMobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 1000px)").matches;
  var size = isMobile ? "36px" : "28px";
  var fontSize = isMobile ? "22px" : "17px";

  var panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = PANEL_ID;
  panel.style.cssText = [
    "position:fixed",
    "top:8px",
    "right:50px",                    // ← 错开 Draw Capture 的 right:12px
    "z-index:2000000",
    "width:" + size,
    "height:" + size,
    "border-radius:50%",
    "background:rgba(20,20,28,0.85)",
    "border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
    "box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)",
    "display:flex",
    "align-items:center",
    "justify-content:center",
    "cursor:grab",
    "user-select:none",
    "touch-action:none",
    "transition:transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s",
  ].join(";");

  const icon = document.createElement("span");
  icon.textContent = "✍️";
  icon.style.cssText = "font-size:" + fontSize + ";line-height:1;pointer-events:none;";
  panel.appendChild(icon);

  // ── 拖动 ──
  let isDragging = false, hasMoved = false,
    startX = 0, startY = 0, panelStartLeft = 0, panelStartTop = 0;

  panel.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    isDragging = true;
    hasMoved = false;
    startX = e.clientX;
    startY = e.clientY;
    panel.style.cursor = "grabbing";
    panel.style.transform = "scale(1.1)";
    panel.style.boxShadow = "0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";

    var rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    panel.style.top = rect.top + "px";
    panel.style.right = "auto";
    panel.style.left = rect.left + "px";
    panel.style.bottom = "auto";
    panelStartLeft = rect.left;
    panelStartTop = rect.top;

    document.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    document.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    e.preventDefault();
  });

  function onMove(e) {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    var dx = e.clientX - startX;
    var dy = e.clientY - startY;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 3 || Math.abs(dy) > 3) hasMoved = true;
    panel.style.left = panelStartLeft + dx + "px";
    panel.style.top = panelStartTop + dy + "px";
  }

  function onUp(e) {
    isDragging = false;
    panel.style.cursor = "grab";
    panel.style.transform = "";
    panel.style.boxShadow = "";
    document.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    document.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    if (!hasMoved) copyToClipboard();
  }

  document.body.appendChild(panel);
  start();

  // ── 轮询 ──
  checkTimer = setInterval(function () {
    if (isMyTaskDisabled()) {
      cleanup("检测到当前任务已禁用，自动关闭");
    }
  }, 2000);

  // ── abort ──
  if (typeof abortSignal !== "undefined" && abortSignal) {
    abortSignal.addEventListener("abort", function () {
      if (isMyTaskDisabled()) {
        cleanup("任务被中止，自动关闭");
      }
    });
  }

  console.log(
    "%c[Prompt Capture] ✍️ 已启动 (" + (isMobile ? "移动端" : "桌面端") + ")",
    "color:#3ecf8e"
  );
})();
<</taskjs>>
